entities.summary: Kathinka von Deichmann is a professional tennis player from Liechtenstein. On 8 October 2018, she reached her best WTA ranking of world No. 153 in singles, and on 17 July 2017, she peaked at No. 343 in doubles. Von Deichmann has won 15 singles and four doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit. Kathinka von Deichmann was a athletes & competitors from Vaduz (b. 1994-05-16, Vaduz).
